title: Favourites (worked example)

summary.problem: Worked example for the hand-off skill: the logged-in Favourites page isn't captured, so its states are designed from the captured listing card.
summary.scope: Saved ads on desktop and mobile web: list, empty, loading and error.

exclude.motion: no motion beyond the card hover already in components.css

rules.text: Un-hearting a saved ad removes it from the list immediately.
rules.test: Tap the heart on a card; the card leaves the grid; when it was the last one, the empty state shows.
QA ovf.long: a 200-character title stays on one line with an ellipsis at 360, 390, 1280 and 1440.

edge_cases: A saved ad removed by its seller: the card should say the ad is no longer available, with a remove action (not drawn: open question).

open_questions.q: Is the page title 'Favourites' or 'My favourites' on live? The logged-in page isn't captured.

changelog.notes: First build of the worked example.
